# Life in the UK Test (LITUT.uk) > Free online course and practice resource for the Life in the UK Test. ## Pages - [Home](https://litut.uk/): Overview of the Life in the UK Test site, study materials and links to practice tests and timelines. Recently updated to this month. - [Course](https://litut.uk/course/): Free Life in the UK Test course materials — modular lessons covering UK values, history, government, society, and practice questions. - [UK History Timeline](https://litut.uk/uk-history-timeline/): Interactive timeline covering major periods in UK history (from Stone Age to modern day). Considered by many one of the best tools to prepare for the test. - [Summaries](https://litut.uk/summaries/): Summary tables of key figures, for quick and easy review. - [Exams / Practice Tests](https://litut.uk/exams/): Real exam-style practice tests and timed mocks to prepare for the official test. - [FAQ](https://litut.uk/faq/): Frequently asked questions about booking, cost, eligibility, and other practical details. ## Description LITUT.uk provides study materials, a UK history timeline, summaries and real-exam-style practice tests to help citizenship and visa applicants (and others interested in UK history/civics) prepare for the Life in the UK Test. Key features: - Free study materials covering British history, government, society, and everyday life. - Interactive UK history timeline. - Practice/exam-style tests to simulate the actual Life in the UK Test. - FAQs providing guidance about the official test, booking, test validity, who needs to take it, etc.
